Subject: Request to postpone Redwood demo — procurement gating (NDA + security questionnaire)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on scheduling the demo. We were very much looking forward to it next Tuesday, but Legal and Procurement have flagged a couple of gating items we need to resolve before a full demo: an executed NDA and completion of your security questionnaire/vendor onboarding form. Legal has attached our signed standard NDA for your records (AcmeHR_NDA_signed.pdf).

Short version: we need to finish vendor onboarding steps before showing the demo with any live data or in-depth implementation discussion. Procurement also needs a vendor contact and checklist to move forward on purchase order terms.

Can we pause next week's demo and reconvene once the onboarding items are done? We expect Legal to be available to finish the questionnaire by the end of next week, but there is some travel on their side the week after which complicates scheduling. Proposed windows: week of Apr 12 or Apr 19 — preferably afternoons PT.

Apologies for the change — happy to keep this high-level if you'd prefer a short intro in the meantime that avoids any PII or configuration specifics.

Attached: AcmeHR_NDA_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Sam Nguyen
Director, HR Systems
Acme HR

Subject: Re: Request to postpone Redwood demo — procurement gating (NDA + security questionnaire)

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up and for sending the signed NDA. Totally understood — we don't want to get ahead of Procurement/Legal.

Two quick options:
1) Pause the current full demo until onboarding + questionnaire are complete. That would allow us to demo with production-like settings.
2) Run a 30m high-level intro next week (no PII, no account config) if you'd like to keep momentum with the stakeholders who can't make it later.

I've looped in Marissa from CS to send our standard vendor onboarding checklist and a link to the security questionnaire, and Rishi from Security to review any technical questions Legal might have. Alex (SE) is on copy for scheduling and to confirm what content we can safely show before onboarding is complete.

If you want to go ahead with option 1, what does week of Apr 12 look like (afternoons PT)? If option 2, I'm available Apr 6 or 7 after 1pm PT.

Happy to be flexible here.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Subject: Redwood vendor onboarding checklist + questionnaire link

Hi Sam — welcome, and thanks for sending the NDA. Attaching our vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx which lists the items Procurement normally needs to complete before a full technical demo or pilot (insurance certs, contact lists, IP/flow diagrams, SCCs where applicable, and a short security questionnaire).

You can complete the questionnaire here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3cAcmeHR-security-questionnaire (I've set it to comment-only for your team so we can track responses).

If it helps, we can do a 30min security/tech pre-call with our security engineer to walk through the questionnaire and clarify items. Typical timeline from another HRIS customer: onboarding + questionnaire takes ~5 business days if Legal/Procurement have bandwidth; otherwise allow 10 business days.

Proposed demo windows (if onboarding done by Apr 9):
- Tue Apr 13 afternoon PT (2:00pm–3:00pm PT)
- Wed Apr 14 afternoon PT (3:30pm–4:30pm PT)

If you prefer the quick 30m intro without onboarding, we can do Apr 6 1:30pm PT. Let me know which path you'd like.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Sam — Rishi from Security here. Happy to run the pre-demo security sync. It helps us accelerate answers for Legal when they review the questionnaire.

I can do the following 30-minute slots (PT):
- Mon Apr 5, 10:00–10:30am
- Tue Apr 6, 11:00–11:30am
- Fri Apr 9, 2:00–2:30pm

If none of those work, we can pick a slot the week of Apr 12 but earlier syncs tend to reduce back-and-forth. On the call we'll cover data classification, access controls, retention, and what we would show in a demo vs what requires completed onboarding.

Also, quick note: if you're going to share configuration screenshots or team-level items in a demo, please confirm those won't include PII. If you want, Marissa can run the short intro demo that shows only UI-level features without connecting to an account.

Thanks,
